notes.title: Version 1.1.6 Released
notes.notes:
The latest, sleeker version of Rogue Contracts: Syndicate has been
released, and, as you will notice, it is focused on speed.

We have edited and upped the pace of the game's introduction,
streamlined the tutorial mission, fixed several glitches, and managed
to speed everything up.

What's more, there are new and much improved sound effects throughout
the game --the sounds of the SMG and the sword slash, to give two
examples-- and we've even touched up the story and RCS's dialog.

Finally, to top things up, we've released a new trailer.

Let us know what you think!
